attr.title: Unreal Tournament '99
attr.desc: Unreal Tournament is Epic's 1999 arena first-person shooter. This PortMaster package runs the OldUnreal 469e Linux ARM64 update with a native OpenGL ES 2 renderer and handheld controls inspired by UT99-Android.
attr.desc_md: Unreal Tournament is Epic's 1999 arena first-person shooter. This PortMaster package runs the [OldUnreal 469e](https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/tag/v469e) Linux ARM64 update using its native OpenGL ES renderer and handheld-oriented controls inspired by [UT99-Android](https://github.com/Andiweli/UT99-Android).
attr.inst: Copy Maps, Music, and Sounds from a legally owned Unreal Tournament installation into ports/ut99/gamedata. Merge the original Textures contents into gamedata/Textures without replacing LadderFonts.utx or UWindowFonts.utx. Do not copy the original System folder.
attr.inst_md: Copy `Maps`, `Music`, and `Sounds` from a legally owned Unreal Tournament installation into `ports/ut99/gamedata`. Merge the original `Textures` contents into `gamedata/Textures` **without replacing** `LadderFonts.utx` or `UWindowFonts.utx`. Do **not** copy the original `System` folder.
